verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents an API-first integration path, including charging customers through the API with your own UI. It also provides sandbox test keys that simulate payments, transfers and webhooks, which supports programmatic, non-UI automation. There is no CLI, no CI-specific guidance, and no published OpenAPI spec (the probe found all candidate paths returned 404), so CI and headless use is implied rather than explicitly supported. missing for 10: official CLI or headless runner, documented CI/automation workflows, machine-readable OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: build fully custom solutions using our APIs
Collect card, bank, and other payment details with your own UI, then charge the customer through the API.
Use test keys to simulate payments, transfers, and webhooks in the sandbox, then switch to live keys and start accepting real payments.
